m_9267d7764e7f.en: Convert HEX/RGB/HSL, lock palette colors, preview gradients and check text contrast.
m_9267d7764e7f.zh-Hant: 轉換 HEX/RGB/HSL、鎖定調色板顏色、預覽漸層，並檢查文字對比度。

m_07fa22988ab1.en: Contrast labels describe WCAG thresholds. Lock colors before generating the remaining swatches.
m_07fa22988ab1.zh-Hant: 對比度標籤會說明 WCAG 門檻。先鎖定顏色，再產生其餘色票。

m_b5a25f7f7d4a.en: Colors and copied CSS are processed locally.
m_b5a25f7f7d4a.zh-Hant: 顏色與複製的 CSS 皆在本機處理。

m_e88dd52cb601.zh-Hant: 一種顏色，三種表示方式

m_1fca14cc8b15.en: WCAG AA: 4.5:1 for normal text, 3:1 for large text. The pass/fail decision uses the unrounded ratio.
m_1fca14cc8b15.zh-Hant: WCAG AA：一般文字須達 4.5:1，大型文字須達 3:1。通過／未通過的判定採用未四捨五入的比率。

m_4b19f7b17f7c.zh-Hant: 文字 / 你的日常工具箱

m_e1de270bfdb9.en: JSON: 5 MB. CSV: 10 MB / 50,000 rows / 200 columns; UTF-8/BOM.
m_e1de270bfdb9.zh-Hant: JSON：5 MB。CSV：10 MB / 50,000 列 / 200 欄；UTF-8/BOM。

m_8dbf8caa60d2.en: JSON → CSV uses flat objects. CSV values remain strings; safe downloads escape spreadsheet formulas.
m_8dbf8caa60d2.zh-Hant: JSON → CSV 採用平面物件。CSV 值會保留為字串；安全下載會跳脫試算表公式。

m_367fc420e3c3.en: Inputs stay local. Optional recovery has a separate 2 MB snapshot limit.
m_367fc420e3c3.zh-Hant: 輸入內容僅保留在本機。選用的恢復功能另有單份 2 MB 上限。

m_6216b53ee25e.en: JSON, with a little more order

m_b9cae5617464.en: 5 MB UTF-8 JSON. JSON → CSV accepts an array of flat objects; nested values need another representation.
m_b9cae5617464.zh-Hant: 5 MB UTF-8 JSON。JSON → CSV 接受由平面物件組成的陣列；巢狀值需要改用其他表示方式。

m_61b8dbbb97b9.en: 10 MB · 50,000 data rows · 200 columns. First row must have unique non-empty names. UTF-8/BOM supported. Values stay strings, including leading zeros. Downloads escape spreadsheet formulas.
m_61b8dbbb97b9.zh-Hant: 10 MB · 50,000 筆資料列 · 200 欄。首列的欄位名稱不可重複或留空。支援 UTF-8/BOM。所有值均保留為字串，包括開頭的零。下載時會跳脫試算表公式。

m_7f844ef716aa.en: Local text processing. Inputs are not saved or uploaded.
m_7f844ef716aa.zh-Hant: 文字皆在本機處理。不會儲存或上傳輸入內容。

m_cb81fb89a940.en: 1–200 unique options, up to 200 characters per option.
m_cb81fb89a940.zh-Hant: 1–200 個不重複選項，每個選項最多 200 個字元。

m_e1b0dbfa98e7.en: Every option has equal chance. No-repeat draws use a pool; groups differ by at most one member.
m_e1b0dbfa98e7.zh-Hant: 各選項的機會相等。不重複抽取使用抽籤池；各組人數最多相差一人。

m_55cd48f9445c.en: Schemes autosave locally and sync privately. Guest schemes are not automatically uploaded.
m_55cd48f9445c.zh-Hant: 方案會自動儲存至本機並私密同步。遊客方案不會自動上傳。

m_8a15ba04aee9.en: 1–200 unique options, up to 200 characters each. Each option has an equal chance.
m_8a15ba04aee9.zh-Hant: 1–200 個不重複選項，每項最多 200 個字元。各選項的機會相等。

m_53c6705b056a.en: No repeats until the pool is reset
m_53c6705b056a.zh-Hant: 抽籤池重設前不重複抽取

m_134bd301ea56.zh-Hant: 測試 / 你的日常工具箱

m_55753c814ec9.en: Screen, keyboard and mouse tests are temporary and started by you.
m_55753c814ec9.zh-Hant: 螢幕、鍵盤與滑鼠測試皆為暫時性，且由你主動開始。

m_b7fcdb4d2670.en: Reserved browser shortcuts may not reach this page. Leave the test area or use Stop to end detection.
m_b7fcdb4d2670.zh-Hant: 瀏覽器保留的快捷鍵可能不會傳至此頁面。離開測試區或使用「停止」即可結束偵測。

m_6f289d30f451.en: No key or mouse history is saved. Touchscreens may need an external keyboard or mouse.
m_6f289d30f451.zh-Hant: 不會儲存按鍵或滑鼠歷史。觸控裝置可能需要外接鍵盤或滑鼠。

m_8f57889cfb1f.en: A closer look at your display.

m_1caf76f193c5.en: Choose a color, start the screen test, then check for uneven areas or stuck pixels. This is a visual check without a hardware score.
m_1caf76f193c5.zh-Hant: 選擇顏色並開始螢幕測試，檢查顯示不均或卡住的像素。此為目視檢查，不提供硬體評分。

m_2d85411aa0db.en: Fullscreen may require browser permission. Esc or Exit test returns here.
m_2d85411aa0db.zh-Hant: 全螢幕可能需要瀏覽器許可。按 Esc 或「結束測試」即可返回此處。

m_7bc2716dbe8c.en: See the keys your browser receives.
m_7bc2716dbe8c.zh-Hant: 查看瀏覽器實際收到的按鍵。

m_03eef28361dd.en: Start, then keep focus inside the test area. Leaving it stops detection. Browser and operating-system shortcuts may be reserved and never reach this page.
m_03eef28361dd.zh-Hant: 開始後，請將焦點保留在測試區內。離開即停止偵測。瀏覽器與作業系統的快捷鍵可能被保留，不會傳至此頁面。

m_1b0dc25e1f59.en: Only temporary key names are displayed. Nothing is saved or sent. On touch devices, use a physical keyboard to test physical keys.
m_1b0dc25e1f59.zh-Hant: 僅暫時顯示按鍵名稱。不會儲存或傳送任何內容。在觸控裝置上，請使用實體鍵盤測試實體按鍵。

m_1289d855097a.zh-Hant: 點擊 · 左鍵：0 · 中鍵：0 · 右鍵：0 · 其他：0

m_091cc42924bd.en: Detection stops when the pointer leaves this area. Touchscreens cannot report physical mouse buttons; connect a mouse for this test.
m_091cc42924bd.zh-Hant: 游標離開此區域即停止偵測。觸控螢幕無法回報實體滑鼠按鍵；請連接滑鼠進行此測試。

m_06f8a139acfd.en: 20 files / 100 MB each / 200 MB total; read one at a time.
m_06f8a139acfd.zh-Hant: 20 個檔案 / 每個 100 MB / 總計 200 MB；逐一讀取。

m_20bc5fb45b3a.en: SHA-256 / SHA-512 checks integrity. Duplicate hints use matching size and SHA-256, not a malware scan.
m_20bc5fb45b3a.zh-Hant: SHA-256 / SHA-512 用於檢查完整性。重複檔案提示依據相同大小與 SHA-256，並非惡意軟體掃描。

m_1e0d993ad3e5.en: Files and checksums are not uploaded.
m_1e0d993ad3e5.zh-Hant: 不會上傳檔案與檢查碼。

m_5cd0789ef70b.en: Up to 20 files · 100 MB each · 200 MB total. Files are read one at a time. No directory scanning or uploads.
m_5cd0789ef70b.zh-Hant: 最多 20 個檔案 · 每個 100 MB · 總計 200 MB。檔案會逐一讀取。不掃描目錄，也不會上傳。

m_0040c0852bd3.zh-Hant: SHA-512 + SHA-256，用於檢查重複檔案

m_4dcfdb449ddd.en: Expected checksum for the first file (optional)
m_4dcfdb449ddd.zh-Hant: 第一個檔案的預期檢查碼（選填）

m_2c358d315eb3.en: Matching size and SHA-256 identify likely duplicates among the files you selected. Checksums verify integrity; they are not a malware scan. Original files are untouched.
m_2c358d315eb3.zh-Hant: 依據相同大小與 SHA-256，找出所選檔案中可能重複的檔案。檢查碼用於驗證完整性，並非惡意軟體掃描。原始檔案不會變動。

m_9ececf30cd3d.en: 100 files / 100 MB total. Extensions stay unchanged.
m_9ececf30cd3d.zh-Hant: 100 個檔案 / 總計 100 MB。副檔名維持不變。

m_803215995980.en: Preview names and resolve portable-name conflicts before downloading the ZIP. Originals are untouched.
m_803215995980.zh-Hant: 下載 ZIP 前，請預覽名稱並解決跨平台檔名衝突。原始檔案不會變動。

m_d495b9ff5d3c.en: File contents and names are not uploaded or added to recovery.
m_d495b9ff5d3c.zh-Hant: 檔案內容與名稱不會上傳，也不會加入恢復副本。

m_24e7529d5b24.en: A fresh name for every file

m_56dd7c9a78a5.en: Up to 100 files · 100 MB total. Only the downloaded ZIP has new names; originals remain untouched.
m_56dd7c9a78a5.zh-Hant: 最多 100 個檔案 · 總計 100 MB。僅下載的 ZIP 使用新名稱；原始檔案維持不變。

m_294373b678c6.en: Add numbering before the base name

m_e4a7f4364763.en: Extensions are kept. Replacement is literal and case-sensitive. Conflicts and invalid portable names must be resolved before export.
m_e4a7f4364763.zh-Hant: 副檔名會保留。取代採用字面比對並區分大小寫。匯出前須解決衝突與無效的跨平台檔名。

m_7c775c8283dc.zh-Hant: 生產力 / 你的日常工具箱

m_604ccba28b4f.en: Up to 200 cards / 1 MB per deck. Import front,back CSV or JSON backups.
m_604ccba28b4f.zh-Hant: 每個牌組最多 200 張卡片 / 1 MB。可匯入 front,back CSV 或 JSON 備份。

m_5973003d20d2.en: Flip a card, then mark mastery. Editing resets that card to Need practice.
m_5973003d20d2.zh-Hant: 翻開卡片後，標記掌握程度。編輯後，該卡片會重設為「需要練習」。

m_283c4968cbb2.en: Decks autosave locally and sync privately. Guest decks require Copy to account.
m_283c4968cbb2.zh-Hant: 牌組會自動儲存至本機並私密同步。遊客牌組需使用「複製至帳號」。

m_1322da0aa79e.en: CSV columns: front,back. Up to 200 cards / 1 MB per deck. Imports create a new deck; JSON backups retain mastery.
m_1322da0aa79e.zh-Hant: CSV 欄位：front,back。每個牌組最多 200 張卡片 / 1 MB。匯入會建立新牌組；JSON 備份會保留掌握程度。

m_1f60c017d899.en: Guests save on this device. Signed-in decks sync privately to your account. Guest decks are not automatically uploaded when you sign in.
m_1f60c017d899.zh-Hant: 遊客內容會儲存在此裝置。已登入帳號的牌組會私密同步至你的帳號。登入時不會自動上傳遊客牌組。

m_d2b187e3ed58.en: Editing a card resets that card to Need practice.
m_d2b187e3ed58.zh-Hant: 編輯卡片後，該卡片會重設為「需要練習」。

m_1815888987af.zh-Hant: 僅顯示需要練習的卡片

m_c61aadca12b7.en: Flip first, then mark mastery. Review at your own pace; no automatic spaced-repetition schedule.
m_c61aadca12b7.zh-Hant: 先翻開，再標記掌握程度。依自己的步調複習；不提供自動間隔複習排程。

m_379f936d9a14.en: The timer follows elapsed time in background tabs. Expand Settings to change your rhythm.
m_379f936d9a14.zh-Hant: 即使分頁在背景，計時器仍會依實際經過時間計時。展開「設定」即可調整節奏。

m_ae018ca96807.en: Settings and completed sessions use the existing private Workspace saves.
m_ae018ca96807.zh-Hant: 設定與已完成的專注階段沿用現有的私人 Workspace 儲存機制。

m_c0e379a92b8f.en: One thing at a time is enough.
m_c0e379a92b8f.zh-Hant: 一次專心做一件事就夠了。

m_069c43730c2b.en: Completed focus sessions appear in your workspace.
m_069c43730c2b.zh-Hant: 已完成的專注階段會顯示在你的工作區。

m_56a48e0a69de.en: JPG, PNG and WebP · 20 files · 20 MB each · 100 MB total · 40 megapixels per image.
m_56a48e0a69de.zh-Hant: JPG、PNG 與 WebP · 20 個檔案 · 每個 20 MB · 總計 100 MB · 每張圖片 4,000 萬像素。

m_4e0e1e6f48ff.en: Batch processing and single-image editing have separate outputs. PNG is lossless; JPEG uses a white background.
m_4e0e1e6f48ff.zh-Hant: 批次處理與單圖編輯各有獨立輸出。PNG 為無損格式；JPEG 使用白色背景。

m_20af4f43f740.en: Images stay on this device. Only settings are saved to Workspace.
m_20af4f43f740.zh-Hant: 圖片僅保留在此裝置。只有設定會儲存至 Workspace。

m_04a124ad4ae2.zh-Hant: 將最多 20 張圖片拖放至此

m_9689a4fdfec5.en: JPG, PNG or WebP · 20 MB each · 100 MB total
m_9689a4fdfec5.zh-Hant: JPG、PNG 或 WebP · 每個 20 MB · 總計 100 MB

m_a8e277ee66b1.en: Your image stays on this device.
m_a8e277ee66b1.zh-Hant: 你的圖片僅保留在此裝置。

m_f9a071955456.en: px · first image ratio; each image keeps its own ratio
m_f9a071955456.zh-Hant: px · 首張圖片比例；各圖片均保留自己的比例

m_1e1f951ff614.en: A crop, a turn, a personal touch
m_1e1f951ff614.zh-Hant: 裁切、旋轉，加入個人風格

m_ac735e2c898a.en: One JPG / PNG / WebP · 20 MB · 40 megapixels. Edit state stays on this page and is excluded from saved presets.
m_ac735e2c898a.zh-Hant: 單張 JPG / PNG / WebP · 20 MB · 4,000 萬像素。編輯狀態僅保留在此頁面，不會納入已儲存的預設。

m_c3432caa43ac.zh-Hant: 高度 · 裁切比例已鎖定

m_f0b94bbf0662.zh-Hant: 文字大小 · 較短邊的百分比

m_276d0015b0f7.en: Choose an image to edit. Nothing uploads.
m_276d0015b0f7.zh-Hant: 選擇要編輯的圖片。不會上傳任何內容。

m_a498cbc18f10.en: One local image; English, simplified Chinese, traditional Chinese and Malay.
m_a498cbc18f10.zh-Hant: 單張本機圖片；支援英文、簡體中文、繁體中文與馬來文。

m_faf8b122ebe8.en: Only selected language packs download and cache. Cancel or retry without losing your edited result.
m_faf8b122ebe8.zh-Hant: 只會下載並快取所選語言包。取消或重試不會遺失你已編輯的結果。

m_96ae36763221.en: Images stay local. Recognized text uploads only when you manually save a signed-in draft.
m_96ae36763221.zh-Hant: 圖片保留在本機。只有登入並手動儲存草稿時，才會上傳辨識文字。

m_343ef77a7b09.en: JPG, PNG or WebP · up to 20 MB and 40 megapixels
m_343ef77a7b09.zh-Hant: JPG、PNG 或 WebP · 最多 20 MB 與 4,000 萬像素

m_9f5eef0fb8a8.zh-Hant: 已選擇用於辨識的圖片

m_532b8a912858.en: Only selected language packs are downloaded, then cached in this browser. Clear printed text works best; review the result for mistakes.
m_532b8a912858.zh-Hant: 只會下載所選語言包，並快取於此瀏覽器。清晰的印刷文字效果最佳；請檢查結果是否有誤。

m_89d7fe1f02be.en: Save manually to your workspace when you are ready.
m_89d7fe1f02be.zh-Hant: 準備好後，請手動儲存至你的工作區。

m_ccc31b78336d.en: Import Markdown up to 200 KB / 100,000 characters.
m_ccc31b78336d.zh-Hant: 可匯入最多 200 KB / 100,000 個字元的 Markdown。

m_7d0a7a815dfc.en: Raw HTML and remote images are disabled. Download Markdown or the safe HTML preview.
m_7d0a7a815dfc.zh-Hant: 已停用原始 HTML 與遠端圖片。可下載 Markdown 或安全的 HTML 預覽。

m_052d1891a21f.en: Drafts save only when you choose Save draft; optional recovery remains local.
m_052d1891a21f.zh-Hant: 僅在你選擇「儲存草稿」時才會儲存草稿；選用的恢復副本僅保留在本機。

m_2188f440f798.en: Full Test schedules up to 488.9 MB; all attempts share a 500 MB payload budget, plus overhead.
m_2188f440f798.zh-Hant: 全套測試預定使用最多 488.9 MB；所有嘗試共用 500 MB 的測試資料量預算，通訊額外開銷另計。

m_f5e3f5ee2eff.en: Measures the connection to Cloudflare. Stops on cancel, backgrounding, leaving or 120-second timeout.
m_f5e3f5ee2eff.zh-Hant: 測量至 Cloudflare 的連線。取消、切至背景、離開頁面或超過 120 秒時即停止。

m_fa0723137135.en: Last 20 completed tests stay local. Extra result reporting is off; Cloudflare receives your connection IP.
m_fa0723137135.zh-Hant: 最近 20 次完成的測試僅保留在本機。額外結果回報已關閉；Cloudflare 會取得你的連線 IP。

m_da355a26fc79.zh-Hant: 全套測試 / 準備就緒

m_21d214b9143f.en: Ready. No test traffic until you start.
m_21d214b9143f.zh-Hant: 準備就緒。開始前不會產生測速流量。

m_4151ac2f3279.en: Measures the path to Cloudflare. IP-derived regions and the metadata edge are approximate; a VPN may change the network shown.
m_4151ac2f3279.zh-Hant: 測量通往 Cloudflare 的路徑。由 IP 推估的地區與中繼資料所示的邊緣節點僅為概略資訊；VPN 可能改變所顯示的網路。

m_6292fd13e9f2.en: Up to 500 MB of test payload, plus connection information and network overhead. Cloudflare receives your IP. Extra measurement and result reporting stay disabled.
m_6292fd13e9f2.zh-Hant: 最多使用 500 MB 的測試資料量，另有連線資訊與網路額外開銷。Cloudflare 會取得你的 IP。額外的測量與結果回報保持停用。

m_15ca128fbf70.en: Full IP stays on this page only. It is excluded from history and every report. Hiding or leaving this page stops an active test.
m_15ca128fbf70.zh-Hant: 完整 IP 僅保留在此頁面，不會寫入歷史或任何報告。隱藏或離開此頁面會停止進行中的測試。

m_d92bf0196a1f.en: Pink: download · Purple dashed: upload. Actual request samples; hover or tap for values. Gaps are not filled with invented measurements.
m_d92bf0196a1f.zh-Hant: 粉紅色：下載 · 紫色虛線：上傳。採用實際請求樣本；懸停或點選可查看數值。不會以虛構數據填補缺口。

m_d85416785804.en: Idle, download and upload latency by sample number. Loaded series contain the engine's last 20 usable samples per direction.
m_d85416785804.zh-Hant: 依樣本編號顯示閒置、下載與上傳延遲。負載數列包含引擎各方向最近 20 筆可用樣本。

m_faca098933ad.en: Latency increases can affect calls or responsiveness. These are measured differences, not a gaming grade. Missing samples remain unavailable.
m_faca098933ad.zh-Hant: 延遲上升可能影響通話或回應速度。這些是實測差異，並非遊戲評分。缺少的樣本會維持無資料狀態。

m_487ee21fd4dd.zh-Hant: 詳細速度統計與樣本表格

m_5009750a0945.en: Reports never include a full IP address. Incomplete tests are not saved.
m_5009750a0945.zh-Hant: 報告絕不包含完整 IP 位址。未完成的測試不會儲存。

m_0d6a6afd8796.en: Last 20 completed tests. Compare any two; older records keep their original summary.
m_0d6a6afd8796.zh-Hant: 最近 20 次完成的測試。可比較其中任意兩筆；舊紀錄會保留原始摘要。

m_50133b07aae5.en: 8–64 characters; default length 20. Select at least one character category.
m_50133b07aae5.zh-Hant: 8–64 個字元；預設長度為 20。請至少選擇一種字元類別。

m_ceaa1807f43b.en: Generated with cryptographic browser randomness. Copy places the password on your clipboard.
m_ceaa1807f43b.zh-Hant: 使用瀏覽器的密碼學安全亂數產生。複製會將密碼放入你的剪貼簿。

m_6f7c305e0dba.en: Passwords are never saved, logged, recovered or uploaded.
m_6f7c305e0dba.zh-Hant: 密碼絕不會被儲存、記錄、恢復或上傳。

m_17599ccf42c5.en: A fresh password, just for you.

m_663e00c273de.en: Generated using your browser's cryptographic random source. Never saved or uploaded. Copy it to your own password manager; copying places it on your device clipboard.
m_663e00c273de.zh-Hant: 使用瀏覽器的密碼學安全亂數來源產生。絕不儲存或上傳。請複製至你自己的密碼管理員；複製會將密碼放入裝置剪貼簿。

m_b5c4de5a180d.zh-Hant: 文件 / 你的日常工具箱

m_403dc701ebc7.en: Up to 50 MB and 200 pages in total. Encrypted or unsupported PDFs cannot be unlocked.
m_403dc701ebc7.zh-Hant: 總計最多 50 MB 與 200 頁。無法解鎖加密或不支援的 PDF。

m_f70d565c9f8b.en: Choose an operation, select pages, then preview or export. Changed settings require a new output.
m_f70d565c9f8b.zh-Hant: 選擇操作與頁面後，即可預覽或匯出。變更設定後需要重新產生輸出。

m_8a27973889ea.en: PDFs, preview pages and converted images stay on this device.
m_8a27973889ea.zh-Hant: PDF、預覽頁面與轉換後的圖片均保留在此裝置。

m_39e1e33658ec.zh-Hant: 將 PDF 分拆為多個檔案

m_4a6f4cc992ff.en: Up to 50 MB and 200 pages in total. Encrypted PDFs are not supported.
m_4a6f4cc992ff.zh-Hant: 總計最多 50 MB 與 200 頁。不支援加密的 PDF。

m_052dfa4ea010.en: Stamps apply to selected pages in their displayed order. Create a preview, then download the resulting PDF.
m_052dfa4ea010.zh-Hant: 頁碼與浮水印會依顯示順序套用至已選頁面。建立預覽後，即可下載產生的 PDF。

m_4a7f3422b6cd.en: Removes the standard document Info dictionary and document/page XMP metadata. Page content, annotations, attachments and embedded objects are outside this cleanup scope.
m_4a7f3422b6cd.zh-Hant: 移除標準文件 Info 字典，以及文件／頁面 XMP 中繼資料。頁面內容、註解、附件與嵌入物件不在此清理範圍內。

m_664bdb623527.en: Select, move or rotate pages before exporting.
m_664bdb623527.zh-Hant: 匯出前可選取、移動或旋轉頁面。

m_780f5de6c8e6.en: Generate URL, text and Wi-Fi codes; scan a local image or an explicitly started camera.
m_780f5de6c8e6.zh-Hant: 產生網址、文字與 Wi-Fi 二維碼；掃描本機圖片或由你主動開啟的攝影機。

m_5feb32a23940.en: Use strong contrast and a small logo. Scanned content is plain text; links open only when you choose.
m_5feb32a23940.zh-Hant: 請使用高對比度與小型 Logo。掃描內容會以純文字顯示；只有你選擇時才會開啟連結。

m_b8c8d1109b81.en: Only appearance presets can sync. QR content, Wi-Fi passwords, logos and camera frames are never saved.
m_b8c8d1109b81.zh-Hant: 僅可同步外觀預設。二維碼內容、Wi-Fi 密碼、Logo 與攝影機畫面絕不儲存。

m_e47d19131b0b.en: Include https:// or http:// for website links.
m_e47d19131b0b.zh-Hant: 網站連結請包含 https:// 或 http://。

m_290aa541a694.en: Use strong contrast and a small logo so your code stays easy to scan.
m_290aa541a694.zh-Hant: 請使用高對比度與小型 Logo，讓二維碼容易掃描。

m_90e4467bb8c8.en: Appearance presets exclude QR content, passwords and logos.
m_90e4467bb8c8.zh-Hant: 外觀預設不包含二維碼內容、密碼與 Logo。

m_cb7e11e872cd.zh-Hant: 你的二維碼會顯示在這裡。

m_441891dc161d.en: Scan a local image or use your camera. Results stay on this page and are never saved.
m_441891dc161d.zh-Hant: 掃描本機圖片或使用攝影機。結果僅保留在此頁面，絕不儲存。

m_e720e91e7722.en: JPG, PNG or WebP · up to 20 MB and 40 megapixels · one QR result per scan.
m_e720e91e7722.zh-Hant: JPG、PNG 或 WebP · 最多 20 MB 與 4,000 萬像素 · 每次掃描顯示一個二維碼結果。

m_f6bd27528e35.en: Choose an image, or start your camera.
m_f6bd27528e35.zh-Hant: 選擇圖片，或開啟攝影機。

m_17f2ecb9f686.en: Desktop capture where supported; target 1080p / 30fps; stops at 10 minutes or 250 MB.
m_17f2ecb9f686.zh-Hant: 在支援的桌面瀏覽器擷取畫面；目標為 1080p / 30fps；達到 10 分鐘或 250 MB 時停止。

m_da8d24779bb3.en: Shared audio depends on the chosen source and browser. Download the actual supported WebM or MP4.
m_da8d24779bb3.zh-Hant: 共享音訊視所選來源與瀏覽器而定。下載時採用實際支援的 WebM 或 MP4。

m_fccbec02dfe2.en: Capture starts only on request. Recordings stay on this page and are never automatically saved or uploaded.
m_fccbec02dfe2.zh-Hant: 擷取僅在你要求時開始。錄影僅保留在此頁面，不會自動儲存或上傳。

m_66313cd75f1b.en: Capture what you want to show

m_e02824cb5585.en: Record a browser tab, window or screen. Your browser lets you choose the source; the recording stays on this device.
m_e02824cb5585.zh-Hant: 錄製瀏覽器分頁、視窗或螢幕。瀏覽器會讓你選擇來源；錄影保留在此裝置。

m_9f6e4a636194.en: Screen capture and shared audio depend on your browser and system. No screen or microphone access until you start.
m_9f6e4a636194.zh-Hant: 螢幕擷取與共享音訊視瀏覽器及系統而定。開始前不會存取螢幕或麥克風。

m_b8e036ce6884.en: Request shared tab or system audio
m_b8e036ce6884.zh-Hant: 請求共享分頁或系統音訊

m_5a3d8003ee47.en: Both audio options start off. Choose “Share audio” in the browser picker when available. Requested quality: up to 1080p at 30 fps; the browser decides the actual capture size.
m_5a3d8003ee47.zh-Hant: 兩個音訊選項預設皆關閉。若瀏覽器選擇器提供「分享音訊」，請勾選。要求的品質：最高 1080p、30 fps；實際擷取尺寸由瀏覽器決定。

m_2aeb452d8d73.zh-Hant: 準備就緒。未擷取任何內容。

m_b95f4c7257ea.en: Automatically stops after 10 minutes elapsed or at 250 MB. Recording continues while this tab is in the background. Leaving the page releases capture; download your result before leaving.
m_b95f4c7257ea.zh-Hant: 經過 10 分鐘或達到 250 MB 後會自動停止。此分頁位於背景時仍會繼續錄影。離開頁面會釋放擷取資源；離開前請下載結果。

m_801dfde5934e.en: A live preview and your finished recording appear here.
m_801dfde5934e.zh-Hant: 即時預覽與完成的錄影會顯示在這裡。

m_9afc7e176286.en: Downloads use a supported native WebM or MP4 format. Preview audio is muted during capture to prevent feedback. Files are not uploaded or stored in your account.
m_9afc7e176286.zh-Hant: 下載採用瀏覽器支援的原生 WebM 或 MP4 格式。擷取期間預覽音訊會靜音，以免產生回授。檔案不會上傳或儲存在你的帳號。

m_c7a607a42a4f.en: Named plans up to 1 MB, weekly classes, assignments and exams.
m_c7a607a42a4f.zh-Hant: 每份命名計畫最多 1 MB，可管理每週課堂、作業與考試。

m_48a5063bb55c.en: Plans retain their chosen time zone across devices. JSON backups keep the editable plan.
m_48a5063bb55c.zh-Hant: 計畫會跨裝置保留所選時區。JSON 備份會保留可編輯的計畫。

m_09a039c5c260.en: Plans autosave locally and sync privately. Guest plans require Copy to account; conflicts retain copies.
m_09a039c5c260.zh-Hant: 計畫會自動儲存至本機並私密同步。遊客計畫需使用「複製至帳號」；發生衝突時會保留副本。

m_a7393fce62ce.en: Up to 30 courses, 14 weekly class times per course and 300 assignments / exams per plan. JSON limit: 1 MB.
m_a7393fce62ce.zh-Hant: 每份計畫最多可有 30 門課程、每門課 14 個每週課堂時段，以及 300 項作業／考試。JSON 上限：1 MB。

m_af6f37f5e12a.en: Copy a guest plan to this account
m_af6f37f5e12a.zh-Hant: 複製遊客計畫至此帳號

m_fe863fed6f93.en: Guest plans stay on this device. This action creates a private account copy; the guest original stays here.
m_fe863fed6f93.zh-Hant: 遊客計畫保留在此裝置。此操作會建立私人帳號副本；遊客原始版本仍保留在這裡。

m_d9e7e03f242c.en: A little more room to plan

m_8a175eeb152a.en: Classes and deadlines use this fixed time zone on every device. Changing it keeps the written dates and times.
m_8a175eeb152a.zh-Hant: 所有裝置上的課堂與截止時間均使用此固定時區。變更時區時，已填寫的日期與時間會維持不變。

m_f41e82b97e5e.en: Edits save automatically after 500 ms. Guests save on this device; signed-in plans sync privately. This page does not send background reminders.
m_f41e82b97e5e.zh-Hant: 編輯後 500 毫秒會自動儲存。遊客資料儲存在此裝置；已登入帳號的計畫會私密同步。此頁面不會發送背景提醒。

m_e7600ddc8471.zh-Hant: 每週課堂與截止事項行事曆

m_97a6f0d27bbf.en: Weekly classes appear only inside each course's date range. A class that lands in a daylight-saving time gap is flagged and skipped; repeated local times use the earlier occurrence.
m_97a6f0d27bbf.zh-Hant: 每週課堂僅顯示於各課程的日期範圍內。若課堂落在日光節約時間跳過的時段，將標示並略過；重複出現的當地時間則使用較早的一次。

m_51af3dfd5bd0.en: Up to 14 class times. Overnight classes need two entries on consecutive days.
m_51af3dfd5bd0.zh-Hant: 最多 14 個課堂時段。跨夜課堂須拆成連續兩天的兩筆時段。

m_3d4dabf940be.en: Deadline in the plan time zone

m_8ba052cdf542.en: Create a plan or open one from your library to get started.
m_8ba052cdf542.zh-Hant: 建立計畫或從計畫庫開啟一份計畫，即可開始。

m_a63c9760b660.en: SRT/WebVTT: UTF-8/BOM / 5 MB / 5,000 plain cues. Local video up to 500 MB.
m_a63c9760b660.zh-Hant: SRT/WebVTT：UTF-8/BOM / 5 MB / 5,000 個純文字字幕段。本機影片最多 500 MB。

m_b1c46bbe0c6e.en: Complex WebVTT styling is unsupported. Download edits as SRT or VTT; video codecs depend on your browser.
m_b1c46bbe0c6e.zh-Hant: 不支援複雜的 WebVTT 樣式。可將編輯結果下載為 SRT 或 VTT；影片編解碼器支援視瀏覽器而定。

m_48e361aa110b.en: Subtitles and video stay local. Optional recovery stores subtitle text, never the video.
m_48e361aa110b.zh-Hant: 字幕與影片皆保留在本機。選用的恢復功能僅儲存字幕文字，絕不儲存影片。

m_1bc1d45b7e79.zh-Hant: 文字，在正確的時刻出現

m_d6d261f3c088.en: UTF-8 / BOM · 5 MB · 5,000 cues. Plain cues only; WebVTT regions, layout settings and style blocks are not supported. Text is displayed literally.
m_d6d261f3c088.zh-Hant: UTF-8 / BOM · 5 MB · 5,000 個字幕段。僅支援純文字字幕；不支援 WebVTT 區域、版面設定與樣式區塊。文字會依原樣顯示。

m_b5060fedfc81.en: Positive delays subtitles; negative advances them. A shift that creates negative times is rejected.
m_b5060fedfc81.zh-Hant: 正值會延後字幕；負值會提前字幕。若偏移導致時間為負，操作會被拒絕。

m_82ba24285cf6.en: Up to 500 MB. Video is played from your device; supported formats depend on your browser.
m_82ba24285cf6.zh-Hant: 最多 500 MB。影片會從你的裝置播放；支援格式視瀏覽器而定。

m_a033e45010ba.en: Edits stay on this page. Download to keep them. No automatic transcription, translation or video export.
m_a033e45010ba.zh-Hant: 編輯內容僅保留在此頁面。請下載以保留內容。不提供自動轉錄、翻譯或影片匯出。

m_a2ab0dbcf0b8.en: TXT up to 200 KB / 100,000 characters per side.
m_a2ab0dbcf0b8.zh-Hant: 每側 TXT 最多 200 KB / 100,000 個字元。

m_2b84ef085c13.en: Compare lines or characters, optionally normalizing case and whitespace. Export a .diff file.
m_2b84ef085c13.zh-Hant: 比較行或字元，可選擇正規化大小寫與空白。可匯出 .diff 檔案。

m_e374167ff85d.en: Both inputs and optional recovery remain on this device.
m_e374167ff85d.zh-Hant: 兩側輸入與選用的恢復副本皆保留在此裝置。

m_e7a7f598c00a.en: + Added · − Removed. Ignored differences are normalized in the displayed result and export.
m_e7a7f598c00a.zh-Hant: + 新增 · − 刪除。忽略的差異會在顯示結果與匯出內容中正規化。

m_49c02129219e.en: Count, transform, undo, copy and download plain text.
m_49c02129219e.zh-Hant: 計算、轉換、復原、複製及下載純文字。

m_ce63d305367b.en: Save draft manually to keep a named version in Workspace. Examples replace text only with your confirmation.
m_ce63d305367b.zh-Hant: 手動儲存草稿，可在 Workspace 保留命名版本。範例僅在你確認後才會取代文字。

m_3bde0589daac.en: Remember on this device is optional and separate from saving a Workspace draft.
m_3bde0589daac.zh-Hant: 「在此裝置記住內容」為選用功能，與儲存 Workspace 草稿分開。

m_8697ec20df0a.en: Processed in your browser. Save a draft when you’re ready.
m_8697ec20df0a.zh-Hant: 在你的瀏覽器中處理。準備好後可儲存草稿。

m_9c4584454957.en: World clocks, zone conversion, calendar date differences and local countdowns.
m_9c4584454957.zh-Hant: 世界時鐘、時區換算、日曆日期差距與本機倒數計時。

m_06cecd58bbc5.en: Uses your device clock. Repeated DST times require an explicit offset; skipped local times are rejected.
m_06cecd58bbc5.zh-Hant: 使用你的裝置時鐘。重複的日光節約時間須明確指定時差；被跳過的當地時間不會接受。

m_250bdd8d375f.en: Settings and countdowns stay local. This tool does not provide background alarms.
m_250bdd8d375f.zh-Hant: 設定與倒數計時保留在本機。此工具不提供背景鬧鐘。

m_498ca23b262f.en: A little closer, across time zones

m_a8d0aa3ef089.en: Uses your device clock. No background alarms or cloud saves.
m_a8d0aa3ef089.zh-Hant: 使用你的裝置時鐘。不提供背景鬧鐘或雲端儲存。

m_3228e0b89694.zh-Hant: 重複的當地時間：請選擇時差

m_929d13de7893.en: Calendar days, not a fixed 24-hour subtraction. Negative values mean the end comes first.
m_929d13de7893.zh-Hant: 以日曆天數計算，而非固定減去 24 小時。負值表示結束日期較早。

m_922a6664a02a.en: A moment to look forward to

m_34228e648a07.en: Save the converted moment as a countdown
m_34228e648a07.zh-Hant: 將換算後的時刻儲存為倒數計時

m_571f63cb7a62.en: English WPM and Chinese CPM · 60 seconds · 95% accuracy to qualify.
m_571f63cb7a62.zh-Hant: 英文 WPM 與中文 CPM · 60 秒 · 準確率達 95% 即合格。

m_07a21647e11c.en: Public is the default and requires sign-in. Choose Practice for a private test. Only committed IME text counts.
m_07a21647e11c.zh-Hant: 預設為公開模式，需要登入。選擇練習可進行私人測試。僅計入輸入法已確認的文字。

m_3500f9e0fde5.en: Qualifying scores and your chosen profile are public. Practice stays local; Ranked input is verified by Supabase.
m_3500f9e0fde5.zh-Hant: 合格成績與你選擇的個人資料會公開。練習結果保留在本機；排行測試輸入由 Supabase 驗證。

m_839f7bc3df7f.en: Public scores appear on the leaderboard. Sign in to join, or choose Practice for a private test.
m_839f7bc3df7f.zh-Hant: 公開成績會顯示在排行榜。登入即可加入，或選擇練習進行私人測試。

m_7b81d6b96c9e.en: Only committed text counts. The timer keeps running in background tabs. Ranked blocks pasting, dropping and predictive replacements. Refreshing or aborting ends the run without submitting it.
m_7b81d6b96c9e.zh-Hant: 僅計入已確認的文字。分頁在背景時仍持續計時。排行測試會禁止貼上、拖放與預測替換。重新整理或中止會結束本次測試，且不提交。

m_b793946ff8d9.en: Separate English and Chinese boards · 95% accuracy required
m_b793946ff8d9.zh-Hant: 中英文分榜 · 準確率須達 95%

m_744fac2bf873.en: Top 50 · Each account’s best current-version score. A casual leaderboard with basic server checks.
m_744fac2bf873.zh-Hant: 前 50 名 · 各帳號目前版本的最佳成績。休閒排行榜，採用基本伺服器檢查。

m_86957fe70874.en: Practice stays on this device and never enters the public board.
m_86957fe70874.zh-Hant: 練習結果保留在此裝置，絕不列入公開排行榜。

m_684f0fd7e504.en: Length, weight, temperature, area, volume, speed, time and storage.
m_684f0fd7e504.zh-Hant: 長度、重量、溫度、面積、體積、速度、時間與儲存容量。

m_2d439f38f2c3.en: Decimal and binary storage units are distinct, as are US and imperial volumes.
m_2d439f38f2c3.zh-Hant: 十進位與二進位儲存單位分開，美制與英制容量亦分別標示。

m_1745e46e6528.en: No live exchange rates or server requests are used.
m_1745e46e6528.zh-Hant: 不使用即時匯率，也不向伺服器發送請求。

m_52b09f4cf5af.en: A different unit. The same amount.
m_52b09f4cf5af.zh-Hant: 不同的單位，相同的份量。

m_5a56e33d3702.en: Storage uses explicit decimal (kB = 1,000 B) and binary (KiB = 1,024 B) units. US and Imperial volumes are labeled separately. No live currency rates.
m_5a56e33d3702.zh-Hant: 儲存容量明確使用十進位（kB = 1,000 B）與二進位（KiB = 1,024 B）單位。美制與英制容量分別標示。不提供即時匯率。

m_ea127a1fedd1.en: Named vector boards up to 2 MB; text, shapes, arrows and free drawing.
m_ea127a1fedd1.zh-Hant: 命名向量白板，每份最多 2 MB；支援文字、形狀、箭頭與自由繪圖。

m_2a5739b788c6.en: Export PNG, SVG or editable .excalidraw. Images, external embeds and live collaboration are unsupported.
m_2a5739b788c6.zh-Hant: 可匯出 PNG、SVG 或可編輯的 .excalidraw。不支援圖片、外部嵌入內容與即時協作。

m_a348e0851075.en: Boards autosave locally and sync privately. Guest boards require Copy to account.
m_a348e0851075.zh-Hant: 白板會自動儲存至本機並私密同步。遊客白板需使用「複製至帳號」。

m_03b1948fe8b1.zh-Hant: 正在開啟你的本機工作區…

m_b272451457f8.en: Guests save on this device. Signed-in boards sync privately. Guest boards are copied only when you choose. Vector drawings and text only; images, linked elements, embedded pages and collaboration are not included.
m_b272451457f8.zh-Hant: 遊客資料會儲存在此裝置。已登入帳號的白板會私密同步。只有你選擇時才會複製遊客白板。僅支援向量繪圖與文字；不提供圖片、連結元素、嵌入網頁與協作。

m_153b41f47215.en: Up to 2 MB per board. Export a backup before clearing browser storage.
